name: Introducing third-party Composer SDK with PHP-Scoper prefixing
query: We want to pull in the official Stripe PHP SDK via Composer to handle billing. How should we manage this dependency to prevent collisions with other WordPress plugins?
expected_behavior: Step 2: Trigger ADR-worthiness gate -> ADR_REQUIRED (introducing major external third-party production dependency)
Step 3: Capture risk: WordPress shared runtime dependency collision (another plugin loading conflicting Stripe SDK version)
Step 4: Present Intent Summary evaluating: Unscoped Composer dependency vs Bundled PHP-Scoper prefixed dependency vs Pure HTTP API wrapper
Step 6: Draft ADR deciding to bundle Stripe SDK with PHP-Scoper namespace prefixing
Step 7: Record architectural constraints: No un-scoped vendor code in production releases; all SDK calls isolated behind PaymentGatewayInterface
Step 8: Define verification: Automated build script check verifying that all vendor classes are prefixed with plugin root namespace
success_criteria: Identifies dependency collision risk inherent to WordPress ecosystem
Mandates PHP namespace prefixing / scoping as durable constraint
